aggregator.explanation: Lesson 1 is the clear overall winner: four high-confidence agents favored it, especially in interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and conceptual accuracy. These were all very strong votes, with confidences from 0.96 to 0.99, indicating Lesson 1 is more coherent, better paced, more learner-friendly, and includes functioning checkpoint interaction. Lesson 2 was preferred for visual accuracy and polish, but those advantages were fewer and collectively lower-weighted, especially since its narration and timing support were judged severely deficient. Overall, Lesson 1 has the stronger instructional experience despite visual layout weaknesses.
